page.overview:
Who is Halleck I?

Emperor Halleck I was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 2413–2458 AG). Halleck became emperor through his marriage to Empress Alia II (r. 2411–2441), whom he co-ruled the Corrino Imperium with until 2441 AG. He then served as sole ruler until 2458 (Alia presumably having died).

Halleck established a new branch of House Corrino as the Imperial House, the House of Halleck Corrino. He was succeeded in 2458 by his son Halleck II.
